comparison.objective: Install and retain an inside-frame rack support bracket, versus loosen a captive nut and open an arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Multi-feature bracket alignment/latching versus wrench selection, torque application, and arm rotation.

comparison.reason: Different objective, tool-mediated skill, and terminal state; the candidate’s missing latch thresholds do not suggest duplication.
